definitions.explanation: Vinegar made from grains such as wheat, corn, or rice. A common, mild-flavored vinegar used in everyday Japanese cooking.

examples.japanese: {穀物酢|こくもつす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a vinegared dish with grain vinegar.

examples.japanese: {穀物酢|こくもつす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手頃|てごろ}→手頃：04068_tegoro⟧で⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Grain vinegar is affordable and easy to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{米酢|こめず}→米酢：24254_komezu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{穀物酢|こくもつす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さっぱりして→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Compared to rice vinegar, grain vinegar has a lighter taste and goes with any dish.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{穀物|こくもつ}→穀物：02806_kokumotsu⟧ (grain/cereal) and ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar). This is the most common and affordable type of vinegar in Japanese kitchens. It is made from a blend of grains (typically wheat, corn, and rice) and has a milder, more neutral flavor than pure ⟦{米酢|こめず}→米酢：24254_komezu⟧ (rice vinegar).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {穀物酢|こくもつす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to season with grain vinegar
- {穀物酢|こくもつす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薄|うす}める→薄める：10055_usumeru⟧: to dilute grain vinegar
- ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧{穀物酢|こくもつす}: pure grain vinegar

TYPES OF VINEGAR:
- ⟦{米酢|こめず}→米酢：24254_komezu⟧: rice vinegar (richer flavor, made from rice only)
- ⟦{黒酢|くろず}→黒酢：17574_kurozu⟧: black vinegar (aged, full-bodied flavor)
- {果実酢|かじつす}: fruit vinegar (apple, grape, etc.)
- ⟦{寿司酢|すしず}→寿司酢：24484_sushizu⟧: seasoned sushi vinegar (pre-mixed with sugar and salt)
